body.p: Reconsideration is requested in view of the above amendments and the following
remarks. The amendments are supported by, for example, paragraph [0065] and Figures 7 and 8. No new matter is added.
Claims 1 - 29 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by U.S. 2017/0164878 to Connor et al. Applicant traverses the rejections.

Connor does not disclose a non-invasive analyte sensor that includes an antenna array having three or four antennas, the antennas are arranged into a first group and a second group, the first group has two of the antennas, the first group is spaced from the second group with no antennas between the first group and the second group, the two antennas in the first group are spaced apart from one another a distance that is less than a distance between the first group and the second group.
Connor discloses a device for non-invasive glucose monitoring. Connor discloses that

the device can operate using radio waves emitted by a transmit antenna and received by a receive antenna. All of the drawings of Connor disclose light emitters, and Connor does not disclose details of the antenna version. In particular, Connor does not disclose an antenna array having three or four antennas, the antennas are arranged into a first group and a second group, the first group has two of the antennas, the first group is spaced from the second group with no antennas between the first group and the second group, the two antennas in the first group are spaced apart from one another a distance that is less than a distance between the first group and the second group.
For at least these reasons, the claims are not anticipated by Connor. Withdrawal of the rejections is requested.
Favorable reconsideration in the form of a notice of allowance is requested. Any
questions concerning this paper can be directed to the attention of the undersigned at (612) 455- 3805.
